title: Counter bound
statement: For finite Turing machines $K$ and $W$ over the Boolean alphabet and a Boolean string $s$, define the counter bound by $4c(s)+2(|s|-p(s))+|s|+1$, where $c(s)$ denotes the counter value and $p(s)$ the counter population count.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ and $W$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
caveat: The snippet does not define `ctrVal` or `ctrPop`; the sentence names their roles but cannot give their meanings.
